messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer (acme-inc) reporting intermittent 502s on hosted API streaming endpoint starting ~10:20 UTC. Error rate jumped to ~7% for their tenant in eu-west.

maria: Short repro they ran from their side (they said >1MB payloads stream):
```
curl --http2 -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"model":"redwood-instruct","input":"<long payload>"}' https://api.eu-west.redwood.com/v1/stream
```

kevin: Can you paste any trace-id or ingress request id the customer included?

maria: They included trace=tr-0a1b2c3d. In our ingress logs I see repeated entries like:
```
[ingress] 2026-03-17T10:21:05Z trace=tr-0a1b2c3d upstream_response_time=0.012 response_code=502
[ingress] error: http2 stream error: STREAM_CLOSED, upstream reset: connection failure
```

kevin: Looks like HTTP/2 stream cancels/resets. Any recent midproxy/envoy changes deployed to eu-west around 10:05–10:15?

aj: Yes — midproxy v2.14.0 rolled to eu-west at 10:05 UTC. It changed the connection multiplexing heuristic to allow more concurrent streams per connection. I also see conn counts increase in the runtime logs.

oncall-sre: Observed metric spike: keepalive connection pool utilization hit 100% at 10:18, and per-connection active stream count spiked x3. Error rate aligns tightly with the deploy window.

maria: Repro from my laptop (eu-west) yields intermittent 502s. Sample output headers from failing request:
```
< HTTP/2 502
< server: envoy
< x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 11
< x-request-id: tr-0a1b2c3d

Body: {"error":"upstream service error"}
```
And debug shows: "connection reset by peer" in the client side.

jamie: Customer applied a temporary workaround by switching to non-streaming (batch) mode on their client and error rate dropped to ~0.2%. They can tolerate that for now but want a root cause and timeline.

aj: Quick mitigation: rolled midproxy back to v2.13.7 in eu-west at 10:45. Post-rollback error rate dropped back to baseline within ~3 minutes.

oncall-sre: Confirmed — error rate reduced from 7.1% -> 0.4% by 10:49. No other obvious infra regressions; CPU/memory healthy.

maria: Filed ENG-RUNTIME-3985 with logs, traces, and the customer repro. Customer notified of rollback and temp workaround.

kevin: Hypothesis: the new multiplexing increased streams per connection which combined with our current keepalive/connpool limits triggers stream resets under large streaming payloads. Also possible HPACK header compression interaction with large/variable auth headers causing premature stream termination — we should validate.

aj: Action items I will own:
- Add synthetic test that simulates many concurrent long-lived streaming clients.
- Add metric for per-connection active-streams in midproxy.
- Evaluate safe connpool_max_streams + keepalive window tuning and roll a canary.
ETA: initial tests + canary tomorrow EOD.

maria: Customer follow-up: we'll keep the rollback active and share progress. Thanks for quick rollback. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Incident INC-2026-0425 created and assigned to eng-runtime oncall. Severity set P2.

kevin: Also propose a tenant-level flag to default prefer_streaming=false until multiplexing is proven at scale.

maria: Saved all logs/traces in ENG-RUNTIME-3985 and sent summary to the customer. Marking this support thread resolved for now — will reopen if errors reappear.
